toggle_switch.title: PS Plus Bypass
toggle_switch.description: Removes PS Plus requirement from online games. Already active — toggle persists across reboots.

toggle_switch.title: Hide PS Plus Nags
toggle_switch.description: Suppress PS Plus upsell panels in the shell.

toggle_switch.title: Sign-In Bypass
toggle_switch.description: Prevents PSN sign-in prompts. Redirect to HEN settings instead. Already active.

toggle_switch.title: Force Offline Mode
toggle_switch.description: Keep network available but block all PSN auth endpoints.

toggle_switch.title: IDPS Spoof
toggle_switch.description: Spoof console IDPS in PSN packets. Requires restart.

label.title: Status
label.description: PS Plus and Sign-In bypasses are patched in memory at boot — these toggles control persistence across reboots.
